name: Romeo Montague (1E)
passive_text: Romeo’s attacks deal +20 while Juliet Capulet is not on your team or has fallen. Caveat: he can never be healed or gain positive statuses from your own Bookmarks.
atk_text: Bought cheap, spent all at once. Costs 20 of your own HP.
blk_text: Negate the attack entirely. Loses 10 HP each time it does.

name: Juliet Capulet (1E)
passive_text: At the start of each of your turns Juliet gains ✨ Highlight if she has no positive status. Caveat: she is perpetually 🫆 Smudged — her ABCs need two correct answers to attach.
atk_text: +10 each turn it stays in play.

name: Mercutio (1E)
passive_name: A Plague on Both Your Houses
passive_text: While Mercutio is your Active, your attacks cost 1 less ABC (min 1). Caveat: he carries a permanent, uncleansable 🫟 Spill (−10 HP each turn).
atk_text: Not so deep as a well, nor so wide as a church door. Inflict 🔥 Burn.
blk_text: Discard a random card from hand to resolve.

name: Tybalt (1E)
passive_name: What, Drawn, and Talk of Peace?
passive_text: Tybalt’s attacks deal +20 against any character with a negative status — he finishes what is already bleeding. Caveat: he can never be healed or gain positive statuses from your own Bookmarks; he will take no help from anyone.
atk_text: He does not fence. He executes. Gains 🗡️ Pierce.

name: Odysseus (1E)
passive_text: Once each turn, attach 1 ABC to Odysseus free of trivia. Caveat: while he is your Active you cannot play Bookmarks — he trusts no one but himself.
atk_text: Only one man in the hall can bend it. Gains 🗡️ Pierce.

name: Athena (1E)
passive_text: While Athena is Backstage, your Active has 🛡️ Laminate. Caveat: she takes no part in the fighting — her own attack costs 1 more ABC.
blk_text: Grant your next Backstage character 📝 Margin Notes.

name: Polyphemus (1E)
passive_text: Polyphemus’ attacks deal +20 while he stands alone with no living Backstage characters. Caveat: he cannot be granted ✨ Highlight, and he takes +10 damage from every attack.

name: Charybdis and Scylla (1E)
passive_text: Their attacks that inflict a status deal +10. Caveat: they carry a permanent, uncleansable 🫟 Spill (−10 HP each turn) and can never be healed — the whirlpool never stops turning.
atk_text: Circe’s arithmetic, and no third answer. Inflict ✂️ Rip and 🔥 Burn.
